newsitem.title: USA: LifeCore Biomed won't meet FY97 net goal.
newsitem.headline: LifeCore Biomed won't meet FY97 net goal.

text.p: LifeCore Biomedical Inc, which on Tuesday reported a profit in the first quarter ended March 31 versus a loss, said it will not meet its goal of profitability for the fiscal year ending June 30.

LifeCore said net income reached $27,000, or nil per share, compared to a loss of $946,000, or $0.09, in the same period a year ago. Sales improved to $4.6 million from $3.7 million last year, LifeCore said.

The company said continued costs, such as those stemming from the delayed resequence of its Lubricoat clinical trial, have contributed to a reduction in previously anticipated profitability in the third and fourth quarters.
LifeCore Biomedical makes medical and surgical devices.
Its shares closed off 15/16 Tuesday at 14.
